scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Assistance for Interest Subsidy to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise (Service Sector)
other_conditions: The enterprise must have obtained acknowledgment or registration from the Ministry of MSME or the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).
Only new MSMEs of the service sector are eligible for the interest subsidy on term loans for new machinery, equipment, and furniture/fixtures (excluding land and building).

The enterprise must submit an online application within one year of the first loan disbursement, commencement of commercial production/services, or GR issue date, whichever is later, and before the scheme's last operative date.
The enterprise must pay regular installments and interest to the bank/financial institution.
benefits_summary: Provides interest subsidy on term loans for service‑sector MSMEs, up to 7% for a maximum of ₹35 lakh per annum for 7 years (Category 1), 6% up to ₹30 lakh for 6 years (Category 2), and 5% up to ₹25 lakh for 5 years (Category 3).
